what: Covers the plate with rounded-square tiles (24px at 1920 width, gap 7%, corner .09), and paints each tile by reading its center color from a six-color ramp flowing top to bottom (paper → yellow-green → lime → green → deep green → black). The plate is divided into 4 vertical bands, and each band’s ramp is offset a little (.045 + random .035), making steps. The ramp flows down once every 6.6s. The tile’s top-left bevel is light and the bottom-right dark, like a carved button. A white four-point starlight appears at the cursor, and tiles within a 7-tile radius are pushed away from the cursor and brighten 10% (follow .15) — on leaving, it slowly settles to .05 (about .8s)

options.tile: Tile side length (px, at 1920 width — scales with width between 1440 and 1920), default 24
options.columns: Number of vertical bands where the lamps are offset, default 4
options.loop: One lamp cycle (sec), default 6.6. 0 stops it
options.radius: Cursor reaction radius (in tiles), default 7. 0 means no cursor reaction
options.shrink: Ratio at which tiles shrink around the cursor, default 0 (original) — .5 scatters them and shrinks about half
options.shift: Lamp phase (0~1) — offset multiple panels on the same page from each other, default 0
options.--fx-c0 ~ --fx-c5 · --fx-gap: Six lamp colors · tile gap color (style · css, Skin variables recommended). If not given: --kf-raised · --kf-accent-soft · --kf-accent · --kf-accent-text · --kf-ink-soft · --kf-contrast-bg, gap --kf-contrast-bg
options.fade: Settling follow rate after the cursor leaves, default .05
options.glint: Starlight strength, default 1. At 0 there is no starlight

note: Each plate uses one WebGL context. When more than ten are laid out on a page, it is better to run a single context like the site does and copy onto 2D canvases (mosaic field in library/green-mosaic-tile-community/shared.js). Nothing is drawn when offscreen. Shaders are drawn once on attach to precompile them.

from.where: index.html .field (hero · band · about · agenda · footer) — measured the original chande-field (Slats band 4 · loop 3 · hoverRadius 7 · hoverEase .15 · hoverMode scatter) and rebuilt it with our own shader
